test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A cricketer's average score over 5 innings is 55. If he scores 166 runs in the sixth inning, by how many runs (rounded to the nearest whole number) will his average score increase?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Old total = 5 × 55 = 275

New total = 275 + 166 = 441

New average = 441 ÷ 6 = 73.5

Increase = 73.5 − 55 = 18.5 ≈ 19

**∴ Answer = 19 runs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 5 innings = 55

Runs in 6th inning = 166

**Formula used:**

Average = Total runs ÷ Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 5 innings = 5 × 55 = 275

⇒ Total runs in 6 innings = 275 + 166 = 441

⇒ New average = 441 ÷ 6 = 73.5

⇒ Increase in average = 73.5 − 55 = 18.5

⇒ Rounded value = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total ÷ Number of observations

New Average

Add new value to total and divide by updated count.

Rounding Rule

0.5 or above rounds up to next integer.
